description: Fallback prior-art search: plain semantic search (Jina embeddings via semantic_text) over `semantic_pitch`, no lexical leg and no reranker. Use it when originality.hybrid_prior_art fails or is unavailable, or to find conceptually similar projects that share no keywords with the idea. Pass the idea as `q` and the number of results as `k`. Returns _id, source, title, tagline, url, year, tags, is_winner and the semantic _score.

configuration.query: FROM {{INDEX}} METADATA _score, _id | WHERE MATCH(semantic_pitch, ?q) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT ?k | KEEP _id, source, title, tagline, url, year, tags, is_winner, _score

q.description: The idea, described in one or two sentences.

k.description: How many results to return (5-15 is a good range).
